title: R6B district - no rear yard required within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two street lines intersecting at 135 degrees or less (ZR 23-344 paragraph (a))
description: DRAFT extraction (needs_review) of ZR 23-344 paragraph (a) 'Within one hundred feet of corners' (Last Amended 2024-12-05) for R6B: 'no #rear yard# shall be required within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two #street lines# intersecting at an angle of 135 degrees or less.' The waiver is encoded as its two stated conditions: (1) the area evaluated lies within 100 feet of the point of intersection - a geometric site fact CONSUMED as the required boolean input within_100_ft_of_street_line_intersection, never derived here; (2) the two street lines intersect at 135 degrees or less - the rule compares the supplied angle (street_line_intersection_angle_degrees) against 135, inclusive. When both hold, the output rear_yard_required_within_100_ft_of_corner is 0 (no rear yard required there). When either does not hold the rule is not applicable: the rear yard of ZR 23-342 / 23-343 (not captured) is then NOT determined by this rule. When either input is unknown, no result is available: professional_review_required, missing_critical, naming the missing input. The section lists R1 through R12 and does not name R6B: the waiver reaches R6B through ZR 11-25 (suffix inheritance), flagged for the reviewer on every result. Own family, read by no consumer yet (the maximum envelope treats rear yards as a non-commensurable gap). NOT a Verified determination. Behind the lane A flag (lane_flag A): indexed only when LANE_A_ENABLED is on.

citations.quote: In the districts indicated, no #rear yard# shall be required within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two #street lines# intersecting at an angle of 135 degrees or less.

All regulations applicable to a district designation shall be applicable to such district designation appended with a suffix, except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution. If a section lists an R4 District, therefore, the provisions of that section shall also apply to R4-1, R4A and R4B Districts, unless separate provisions for the districts with suffixes are listed within such section.

inputs.name: zoning_district
inputs.description: Residence district governing the lot. Scope is enforced by applicability (in_set R6B), not an input enum: any other district is a visible not_applicable.

inputs.name: within_100_ft_of_street_line_intersection
inputs.description: True iff the area of the zoning lot being evaluated lies within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two street lines (ZR 23-344(a)). A geometric site fact (Lane B) consumed as an input, never derived here. Not supplied -> the rear-yard result is not available (professional_review_required, missing_critical, no value).

inputs.name: street_line_intersection_angle_degrees
inputs.description: Angle, in degrees, at which the two street lines intersect at that point (a geometric site fact, Lane B; never derived here). ZR 23-344(a) requires 135 degrees or less; the rule applies that comparison (135 itself qualifies). Not supplied -> the rear-yard result is not available (professional_review_required, missing_critical, no value). Declared dimensionless because the legal unit vocabulary has no angle unit; the value is in degrees.

inputs.name: overlay_present
inputs.description: True iff a commercial overlay is mapped on the lot (canonical profile zoning.commercial_overlays[] non-empty). Only adds the commercial-overlay note (exception commercial_overlay_not_captured); when not supplied the result escalates to professional review (fail-closed, DF-6).

inputs.name: special_district_present
inputs.description: True iff a special purpose district is mapped on the lot (canonical profile zoning.special_districts[] non-empty). When true -> professional_review_required; when not supplied -> professional_review_required (fail-closed, DF-6).

outputs.name: rear_yard_required_within_100_ft_of_corner
outputs.description: 0 = no rear yard is required for the area within 100 feet of the point of intersection (ZR 23-344(a)). The rule never emits 1: where the waiver does not hold the rule is not applicable, and whether a rear yard is required (ZR 23-342 / 23-343, not captured) is not determined here.

parameters.name: rear_yard_required_when_waived
parameters.note: ZR 23-344(a): 'no #rear yard# shall be required' - written 0 (not required). The two conditions (within 100 feet of the point of intersection; 135 degrees or less) are the applicability predicate.

steps.note: ZR 23-344(a): no rear yard is required within 100 feet of the point of intersection of two street lines intersecting at an angle of 135 degrees or less (both conditions hold: see the applicability trace).

exceptions.description: ZR 23-344 lists 'R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6 R7 R8 R9 R10 R11 R12' and does not name R6B. This waiver reaches R6B through ZR 11-25: provisions of a section that lists an R district also apply to that district with a suffix unless the section lists separate provisions for the suffixed districts, which 23-344 does not. This is a reading of 11-25, not an express naming of R6B and not an owner decision: the reviewer (Q12) must confirm it, including 11-25's 'except as otherwise set forth in express provisions of this Resolution'.

The waiver covers only the area within 100 feet of the point of intersection. For any part of the zoning lot beyond it, the rear yard follows ZR 23-342 / 23-343 as modified by 23-344(b) to (d); 23-342 and 23-343 are not captured, and 23-344(b) to (d) are not encoded, so that part's rear yard is NOT determined by this rule.

A commercial overlay is mapped on this lot. This is the R6B residence-district rear-yard waiver of ZR 23-344(a). The commercial-district provisions that apply to buildings in a commercial overlay (ZR Article III) have not been captured or encoded, so a reviewer must confirm this waiver governs the building proposed, in particular one with non-residential floor area.

A special purpose district is mapped on this lot and may modify residence-district yards; its provisions are not captured or evaluated here, so the result is not emitted as final. Professional review required.

special_district_interactions.description: Special Purpose Districts (ZR Articles VIII-XIV) may modify residence-district yards. When one is mapped, its provisions govern and must be evaluated by the corresponding special rule; this rule does not apply the modification and escalates to professional_review_required via special_district_modification.

uncertainty_policy.note: An uncertain, split, sliver, or invalid M2-T013 geometric district assignment is never collapsed into a single definitive district: coverage downgrades to professional_review_required (or data_conflict) and the geometric uncertainty is recorded in the trace.

limitations: Draft extraction pending independent review and G6 qualified-human legal approval; not a Verified determination.

Only paragraph (a) for R6B is encoded; paragraphs (b) to (d), including the R6-R12 waivers of (c)(3) and (d)(3) where a rear lot line coincides with a side lot line of an adjoining zoning lot, are captured in the snapshot but not encoded.
The 100-foot test and the intersection angle are site facts supplied by the caller; this rule never measures geometry.
Sections 23-342 (Rear yard requirements), 23-343 (Rear yard equivalent requirements), 23-38 and 23-72 - titles as shown in the portal navigation - have not been captured or evaluated.
